links.outcome: F1 on external institution notes versus human-annotated ground truth for SBDH extraction
links.effect: Macro-average F1 0.94 to 0.98 across 6 SBDH categories on the UTSW external validation set (971 notes); any-adverse-attribute F1 0.97, recall 0.97, precision 0.98.
links.quote: When tested on the UTSW validation set, SBDH-Reader achieved a macro-average F1 ranging from 0.94 to 0.98 across 6 SBDH categories.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering of a general-purpose LLM for structured SBDH extraction from clinical notes without task-specific fine-tuning

screen.reason: Evaluates an LLM-based method (SBDH-Reader using GPT-4o) for extracting social and behavioral determinants of health from clinical notes across MIMIC-III and an external hospital validation dataset, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
